# DeepEval

Skills that teach agents to work with DeepEval. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [confident-ai/deepeval](https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval), at commit `da9b2c9`.

Skills for adding DeepEval evaluations, tracing, datasets, Confident AI reports, and iterative improvement loops to AI applications.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **DeepEval**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **DeepEval**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install deepeval@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

3 skills: `deepeval`, `deepeval-otel`, `deepeval-tracing`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

5 script files ship inside the skills. The agent can run them on your machine. Read them first.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `CONFIDENT_API_KEY`. This plugin does not store them.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval
